subject: Genetics
title: Who Decides
description: A quick win: understand Who Decides.

hook.text: Scientists say: proceed with caution. Governments say: ban it for now. Patients with genetic diseases say: hurry up.

buildup.text: No global body governs gene editing. Each country sets its own rules. China, the U.S., and the UK all differ.

discovery.text: The WHO created an advisory committee in 2019. Its recommendations are non-binding. Enforcement is zero.

twist.text: Religious groups, disability advocates, and bioethicists all disagree on limits. There is no consensus to enforce.

climax.text: Governance is racing behind technology. By the time rules are written, the science will have moved three steps ahead.

punchline.text: The technology is global. The rules are local. That's the gap.

quiz.question: What is the WHO's gene editing advisory committee's power?
